ten_batch: Lib Core Utilities - Supabase, Cache & Query
mo_ta: Các utilities cốt lõi: Supabase client setup (browser/server/middleware), hệ thống cache đa tầng (SWR, React Query, server cache), cache invalidation, React Query hooks cho contracts, performance monitoring, validation, và core utilities

chuc_nang_chinh: createClient() - Tạo browser client với env variables
files.pattern: SSR browser client pattern từ V1

files.mo_ta: Supabase server client cho server components và actions - hỗ trợ cả user client (RLS) và admin client (bypass RLS)
chuc_nang_chinh: createClient() - Cached server client với RLS (sử dụng user JWT từ cookies)
createAdminClient() - Cached admin client bypass RLS (service role key)

files.mo_ta: Next.js middleware - xử lý auth session refresh, protected routes, và auth timing profiler
chuc_nang_chinh: updateSession() - Middleware chính: refresh session, check auth, redirect
Auth performance profiler - Log slow auth checks (>700ms mặc định)
Protected routes vs public routes logic
clearAuthProxyHeaders() - Xóa auth proxy headers
flow: 1. Tạo Supabase client với cookie handlers
4. Nếu chưa auth & route protected → redirect /login
5. Nếu đã auth & đang ở /login → redirect /dashboard
6. Return response với noStore() cache headers

key_patterns: Supabase SSR pattern: browser client (anon key) vs server client (cookies) vs admin client (service role)
Multi-layer cache: Server in-memory cache (TTL) → SWR (client cache) → React Query (contracts only)
Cache invalidation: Client-side (SWR + React Query) + Server-side (revalidatePath + revalidateTag)
React Query migration: Contracts module đã migrate từ SWR → React Query
Query keys factory: contractKeys object với nested structure
Prefetch strategy: hover prefetch + viewport prefetch (IntersectionObserver)
Toast system: Deduplication, loading flows, batch operations, server action integration
Performance monitoring: Action profiler, dashboard Web Vitals tracking
Amount validation: Prevent negative amounts và overflow (0 to 10B VND)
Period lock check: Prevent mutations trong closed accounting periods
RPC fallback pattern: Try RPC → fallback to query if missing
